about: A round commits whole or not at all. Capture precedes step 1; an unhandled exception or cancellation in steps 1-10 before durable completion aborts the round. The build injects faults through test hooks, without network calls.
world: LF-1, shock branch, round 10 (t=40h): payroll 50,000.00 is due and clears as a mandatory settlement
abort_order: close admission for the failing round
cancel and join all round-owned actor tasks and their children
establish that no failed-round writer remains
allow a retry only after restoration completes

failed_round_expect.all_captured_state: equal to round-start capture; failure diagnostic is separate from committed actor history
failed_round_expect.retry: retry the same round with ScriptedModel after removing the injected fault; compare to a fresh clean control from the same capture
failed_round_expect.quiescence: no round-owned task can write after restoration begins; an instance with unproved quiescence is unusable and cannot retry
failed_round_expect.boundary: these cases inject exceptions or cancellation before durable round completion; process-crash recovery, identical fresh live-model responses and reversal of external model charges are not proved

actor_interleaving.arrange: an actor writes a provisional public post, memory entry and queued intent, then pauses on a test barrier before another write; another actor or the coordinator triggers the abort
actor_interleaving.sibling_cleanup: the paused actor attempts one final provisional memory/queue write during cancellation cleanup, before it terminates; this write must be removed by the subsequent restoration
actor_interleaving.assert_order: task and child completion precede restoration; release all test barriers after abort and prove no writer can alter restored state
actor_interleaving.synchronisation: explicit test barriers and lifecycle records, not wall-clock sleeps

inject.after: a synthetic due event changes state and advances the event cursor; fail before observations
the sibling actor reaches the provisional-write barrier
inject.failure: another actor raises an unhandled exception

inject.after: the sibling actor reaches the provisional-write barrier
the first mandatory settlement journal is written
journals written, before the transcript append

invalid-intent.note: a rejected intent is not a failed round; the mandatory settlement still runs
